description.value: Sushi House is a Japanese restaurant in Duncan on the Trans-Canada Highway offering sushi, teriyaki, sashimi, and Korean dishes made from fresh, globally sourced ingredients. The restaurant positions itself as a relaxed dine-in destination and also offers online ordering with pickup. Its highway location makes it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley.
